Subject: Urgent account review needed

Hello,

I am writing on behalf of Marcus Thorne regarding his Platinum Plus membership at the Downtown branch. This morning, Marcus received an automated system notice stating: 'Service Interruption: Our mobile app is currently unable to authenticate users due to a server error (Code 503). You may be unable to log in.'

Although Marcus initially thought this might be a glitch since he traveled recently, he just tried to access his digital key and saw a $49.99 'Guest Pass Upgrade' charge that he definitely did not authorize. He suspects the system error prevented him from seeing earlier activity. While the email suggests simply waiting for servers to reset, Marcus cannot access his profile at all to verify the charge or manage his settings. Please prioritize fixing the login fault and error message so he can regain access to the product features. We need the technical outage resolved before we can discuss any billing adjustments or security concerns regarding the upgrade.

Customer: The May outage is fixed. That is all for today.
Agent: Do you need anything else?

Someone else logged into my gym account and changed my password yesterday. But honestly, I just want to cancel my membership right now; stopping the renewal is my top priority. You can look at the login later.

Estou farta dessa bagunça nos pedidos do escritório. O João da contabilidade disse que talvez cancele o plano 'Business' se os preços subirem mês que vem, mas deixei claro: NÃO estou cancelando nada agora. Ele também mencionou que a Maria quer fazer downgrade na conta pessoal dela, não na nossa corporativa. Enquanto isso, tivemos um erro estranho no app às 14h: código E-902 ao tentar finalizar o pedido de almoxarifado. A taxa de entrega veio cobrada duas vezes na fatura de outubro, valor R$ 48,90. Não sei se devo falar do erro primeiro ou da cobrança. Aliás, o pedido das 12h chegou atrasado, mas já foi resolvido com o motorista. Preciso saber qual é o procedimento exato para cada uma dessas situações separadamente antes de tomar qualquer atitude. Não adianta me responder genérico.
Hi, my main issue is understanding why the price increased to $14.99 this month; this is urgent. Also, the app keeps crashing with error code 402 whenever I try to unlock my vault. Thanks, Alex.
App shows error 404 when scanning plates; actually, what is this $5 charge?
